title: ClickHouse failover-test: Keeper quorum survives 1-node loss
description: The nexus-cli failover-test verb for the analytics tier: stop the Keeper RAFT leader (3-of-3 -> 2-of-3 still quorate), verify the quorum re-elects within a few seconds and ReplicatedMergeTree inserts still commit (replication coordination uninterrupted), then restore the member.

steps.command: for ip in 192.168.70.41 192.168.70.42 192.168.70.43; do echo -n "$ip "; ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@$ip "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/9181; printf 'mntr\n' >&3; timeout 3 cat <&3 | grep zk_server_state"; done

observe.what: identify the current Keeper leader (the one reporting zk_server_state=leader) -- record its IP as $KEEPER_LEADER
(silent) the RAFT leader is now down -- 2 of 3 remain (still quorate)

steps.command: for ip in 192.168.70.41 192.168.70.42 192.168.70.43; do ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@$ip "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/9181; printf 'mntr\n' >&3; timeout 3 cat <&3 | grep zk_server_state" 2>/dev/null; done

observe.what: one of the 2 survivors now reports leader (re-elected within ~RAFT election timeout); the killed node is silent/connection-refused

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.44 "clickhouse-client --secure --host localhost --port 9440 --query 'INSERT INTO nexus.events SELECT number+2000000, now(), number%3, ''failover'' FROM numbers(20)'; clickhouse-client --secure --host localhost --port 9440 --query 'SELECT count() FROM nexus.events WHERE payload=''failover'''"

observe.what: 20 -- a ReplicatedMergeTree insert still commits with 1 Keeper down (the surviving 2-node quorum coordinates replication)
restarted member rejoins the quorum as follower (back to 3 members)

whatProves: the 3-node ClickHouse Keeper RAFT quorum tolerates a 1-node loss (2/3 still quorate), re-elects a leader within seconds, and ReplicatedMergeTree replication coordination is uninterrupted -- the analytics-tier fault tolerance the failover-test verb measures (RTO captured from the mntr re-election delta).
